newsitem.title: USA: Safety-Kleen Q2 hurt by lube oil pricing.
newsitem.headline: Safety-Kleen Q2 hurt by lube oil pricing.

text.p: Safety-Kleen Corp, an industrial and environmental service company, said its results for the second quarter ended June 14 were hurt by depressed lube oil pricing.

"Had pricing remained constant with prices in the second quarter of 1996, consolidated revenue and net earnings for the second quarter would have increased by 10 percent and eight percent, respectively," chief executive John Johnson Jr. said in a news release Tuesday.

The company reported net earnings of $13.4 million, or $0.23 a share for the second quarter, compared with $13.6 million, or $0.23 a share, a year ago. Revenues for the quarter were $229.9 million, up from $211.4 a year ago.
The company also said margins were hurt by startup costs associated with new businesses.
"We believe these services will begin to contribute to earnings momentum by year-end," Johnson said.
Safety-Kleen shares were down 15/16 at 16-5/16 Wednesday.
